entries.title: Psalms 98:1
segments:
PSALM XCVIII. 
 
  This psalm sets forth the glory of the Redeemer, ver. 1-3.   And the joy of the redeemed, ver. 4-9.   A psalm.

entries.title: Psalms 98:2
segments: V. 2. Salvation-The redemption of the world by the Messiah: which was hitherto reserved was a secret among the Jews, yea was not throughly known by the most of the Jews themselves.  Righteousness-His faithfulness in accomplishing this great promise.
